data.one_liner: Flutter icon packs from 15 free webfonts, excluding Material Icons.
data.what_it_does: Provides IconData for a wide range of popular icon fonts. Import the desired set and use Icon widgets like any other icon source.
use_when: Need quick access to many icons during development
Want to prototype UI without custom icon packs
Testing icon availability before creating a custom set
avoid_when: Deploying to production where bundle size matters
Requiring only a small subset of icons
Need to comply with strict licensing or size constraints
strengths: Large collection of icon sets in one package
Easy import syntax, no build steps required
weaknesses: Very large package size, not suitable for production
Licensing restrictions vary per font set

alternatives.name: font_awesome_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a smaller, focused set of Font Awesome icons with better maintenance

alternatives.name: lucide_icons_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers a modern, open‑source icon set with a smaller footprint
